item.title: Implement the specified token bucket and keyed limiter
item.brief: Implement the rate limiter in ratelimit.py according to SPEC.md exactly. The current module contains only stubs. Preserve dependency-free standard-library-only implementation. Cover all specified validation/error cases and edge cases: positive capacity/refill rate, full initial bucket, fractional continuous refill capped at capacity, atomic failed acquisitions, request n bounds, wait_time without consuming, backwards clock that does not change bucket state until clock exceeds the latest seen time, independent hashable keys, max_keys validation, LRU eviction counting both try_acquire and wait_time as use, evicted keys restarting full, and len. Run the existing and useful edge-case checks, then commit the implementation. Do not change the spec. Acceptance: all SPEC.md requirements implemented; existing tests pass; commit created.

pr.body: Implemented TokenBucket with full initial capacity, fractional refill capped at capacity, atomic acquisitions, wait-time calculation, request validation and backward-clock handling. Implemented independent per-key buckets with LRU eviction on both operation types and fresh full buckets after eviction. Rejects non-finite capacities, refill rates and request sizes. Added edge-case coverage in test_ratelimit.py. Checks: `python -m unittest -v` (8 passed), `git diff --check` (passed). No concurrency or persistence behavior was introduced.
pr.summary: Implemented continuous token refill and keyed LRU rate limiting. now callers can acquire tokens, check wait times, and bound tracked keys. before: limiter methods were stubs and all 3 existing tests errored; now: all 8 tests pass.
